notes.title: RELEASE!
notes.content:
At last, came this, perhaps, most exciting day for any team as a whole and each developer individually – the day of [b]RELEASE![/b]

Our path to this event lasted exactly 1 year, 9 months, 23 days. Someone will say that this is very little, because it often takes several years to make a game. Sure, we say, we know that, nevertheless, this is how long it took us.

[i]It is hard to find proper words to describe our feelings right now![/i]

It cannot be said that we have passed this path in one breath, and most likely it is beyond the power of anyone. During this time, many things happened, joy, overestimation of strength, disappointment, arguments, hysterics (from laughter), devastation, ambition, drive, meeting interesting people, a second wind, etc. One thing I would like to note, in spite of everything we traveled this path in a very organized way, as a whole, as a real team, which is obsessed with one idea and strives to achieve the goal, and we achieved this goal! 

[b]Thanks to everyone who was with us along the way![/b]

It is not for us to judge our product, in which we have invested our soul, here it would be most appropriate to quote Andrey Viktorovich Yaroslavtsev, one of the masters of Russian voice acting, with whom we were lucky to work on the project.
[quote=author][i]Well, we have all done a lot of work, we can only hope that the players will meet the game with interest and appreciate it[/i][/quote]

I would like to note another very important point, during the development, we all and each individually received tremendous experience, which, after some processing, will certainly become very useful when working on the next projects, which, we hope, will not keep us waiting long.

Among other things, there was another very important and pleasant event on our way that we would like to share. Around the middle of development, we found out that a replenishment was expected in the family of one of our colleagues, and 9 months later, shortly before the release, they had a daughter, who was named with a beautiful name - [i]Evangelina[/i]!

[b]Thank you for your attention and enjoy the game![/b]

[i]Best regards,
Mikola Games team[/i]

[b]P.S.[/b] Until September 27, the game can be purchased with a 15% discount

notes.title: The full version of the game (6 acts) is ready! Some tests and then RELEASE!
notes.content:
[b]Hello dear friends![/b]

We are glad to inform you that the full version of the game, all 6 acts, is complete!

It would seem that since the game is ready, we can safely go to release, but we decided not to rush, because we do not want you to be disappointed if you come across bugs that we could not find during our own tests.As practice shows, games behave differently on different computers, and considering that 
 our team is small, we, with all our desire, are physically unable to conduct full-scale tests and identify all the errors. In this regard, we turn to you for help to find all the bugs so that we could fix them and then release the game with a clear conscience!

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] We plan to spend no more than a few weeks on the tests!

Since entering early access, a lot has changed in the game, not even counting the addition of the 5th and 6th acts - based on your feedback, quests, locations have been partially, and somewhere completely changed and reworked, achievements have also been worked on, many have been removed, new ones have been added for new acts.

[i]Best regards,
The development team[/i]

notes.title: We invite bughunters to our team
notes.content:
[i][b]Hello dear friends![/b][/i]

Some time ago, we published our plans for the future of the project, in which we said that we decided not only to finalize the game but also to partially rework some of the existing elements of the game. You can read in more detail about it [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1122780/announcements/detail/3964793731452008352]HERE[/url][/b]

All was fine and dandy, but after releasing the game into the early access we realized that finding game bugs was a bit more complicated than we could imagine, partly because our team is quite small and we physically cannot do it all by ourselves. To avoid this in the future, we have the courage to ask you for help in this difficult matter.

We will be very grateful to everyone who responds and decides to join our small but very ambitious, goal-oriented and friendly team, thereby becoming one of us to work on the Highly Likely project together.

We will be very gratefulːsteamhappyː

In order to join us and get access to the test build of the game, just add [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/MikolaGames/]Mikola[/url][/b] as your friend and write him a message!

notes.title: Plans for the near future!
notes.content:
Hello, dear friends!

We are glad to share some important news regarding our plans for nearest future.

Friends, during the first few weeks since the day when our game became available, we’ve heard from you a lot of reviews, suggestions, requests, advice, wishes, etc. 

[b]Thank you so much for participating in our project![/b]

We did not disregard any of your comments, both on Steam and other sites, including YouTube, where reviewers and streamers themselves and their viewers expressed their opinion.

Having collected all the information and analyzed it, and after taking into account our plans, we decided on the course of further development of the game for the near future. First of all, this applies to new content, gameplay and the atmosphere of the game as a whole, which, without a doubt, will make it even more fun and diverse.

The game will be filled with new quests, animations, graphics, sounds, etc. We are going to partially or completely rework some existing quests that you can find at various locations, for example, at the fair there will be a quest with 13 characters involved, a shooting gallery and a tavern “Three Donkeys” will become available, where you’ll be able to meet new characters. We will add vehicles for movement through the game world, and also slightly reduce some locations in size so that you do not get tired of walking aroundːsteamhappyː

[b]Additions will affect ALL acts![/b]

Well and, of course, we will add the 5th and 6th acts to the game, which will bring new content, as well as new intrigues and of course the answer to the main question: how did the story end and if our Mikola was able to solve his problems?

We hope that you will meet the new changes with interest and appreciate them. As for the time frame, we plan to finish all this by the end of the early access period. We will periodically inform you about the development process and will be happy to hear your opinion.

[i]Best Regards, Mikola Games Team[/i]

[b]List of work done:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Animation. We fixed the bugs due to which several objects appeared at the same time or disappeared altogether.

[*] Sound. Corrected the bugs due to which there were overlaying sounds and some other inconsistencies. Added sounds to the fair.

[*] Inventory. Fixed bugs due to which it was possible to change the active item during the action.

[*] 4th act. Particular attention was paid to the broken parallax in the second half of Act 4, when Mikola wakes up and a dialogue with the Wife begins.

[*] Cut scenes. They also got a little attention.

[*] In addition to all of the above, we worked hard to fix a number of other minor and major errors that disrupted the gameplay and spoiled the impression of the game.
[/olist]
[b]Enjoy the game![/b]ːsteamhappyː

[b]P.S. [/b][i]The build was tested by regular testers, everything went perfectly, we hope that everything will go smoothly for you as well and you will be satisfied with the game.[/i]

notes.title: The day has come! The game is available!
notes.content:
Dear friends! This day has arrived, the game is available to everyone (we hope that at least 5 people really waited for this moment) ːsteamhappyː

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QoSDzV5.png[/img]

Highly Likely is our first but, hopefully, not last project. From the first days of working on the project, it was very important for us that the players enjoyed the game, so we approached the matter with great responsibility and enthusiasm. We have worked and continue working tirelessly!

We are excited, we worry and believe, and also sincerely hope that you have met the game with interest and appreciate our efforts, as well as share with us all those emotions that overwhelm us.

We will be grateful if you kindly agree to share your impression of the game with us. Your opinion will be invaluable support for us. Feedback or a personal assessment, no matter how critical they may be, will allow us to look into the future with confidence, will inspire further fruitful work.


[i]We would like to say a few words about the delayed release.[/i]

First of all, our game is a story with a fascinating and rich tragicomic plot divided into acts. It is planned that the game will consist of 6 acts. Initially, our plan was to release 4 acts as the base game, and then continue working on the acts 5 and 6, which would be released simultaneously a few months later as a DLC. But, after some thought, we decided not to divide the game, but to release all the 6 acts at once. We hat to decide if we should postpone the release of the game or release the game into early access with 4 acts, and continue working on the remaining acts after that. You already know our decision!



[b]IMPORTANT!!![/b] Dear players, we want to be honest with you from the very first day, so read this information carefully!

We really want you to have only positive emotions from the game process, but, like in any game, especially one which is still in the process of its creation, there are still a lot of bugs in our game that we work on daily, but our team consists of only nine people, and it’s unlikely that we can do everything quickly, and in this regard we are counting on your patience and understanding.

[i]By the way, you can report the bugs you find in the game [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1122780/discussions/0/1740013516076345125/]HERE[/url][/b][/i]

On the other hand, if you are one of those who, on the contrary, likes to participate in the process of creating or testing games, you want to offer your ideas, help with catching bugs, just give advice and share your opinion, then without hesitation purchase the game and welcome to the team! Yes, yes, to the team, and these are not just windy talk, because we will finish the game and release it together!

[i]With deep respect to you, the Mikola Games team.[/i]

notes.title: The Tale of How Our Colleague had a “dialog” with Feminists
notes.content:
Hello, dear friends!

We decided to share one story that happened not so long ago, and believe me, it is to be continued...

You all probably know cases when representatives of the feminist movement (or other movements) expressed their dissatisfaction with certain games, sometimes creating a scandal out of thin air and thereby jeopardizing the reputation of developers, leaving a negative mark on the team and project that often put their soul, time and money into it.

Can you say honestly, you also probably thought that all these were accidents and all these “Robin Hoods” are fighting an open-minded battle, guided exclusively by objective reasons and their inner convictions? As it turned out, this is far from the true, at least the experience of our comrade is an evidence to this.

We will tell you one story from which many of you will learn something new about this business. You’ll be able to take a peek behind the curtain of this lair of hypocrisy, cynicism and double standards.

Our story is about how one of our employees “talked” with representatives of the feminist movement. The word «talked» is not in quotation marks by accident, since there was no communication as such, but instead there was a very funny story…


Original on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/KotakuInAction/comments/dkyaoi/gamingwe_a_small_gamedev_team_tried_to_contact/]Reddit[/url]

notes.title: Steam Gift Card Giveaway from Highly Likely Developers
notes.content:
Hello dear friends!

To celebrate the upcoming release of the game, we decided to run a giveaway of Steam digital gift cards with a total cost of more than $3000.

We will give away 105* gift cards!

[list]
[*] [b]$100 – 3 cards.
[*]$50 - 10 cards.
[*]$25 - 37 cards.[/b]
[/list]

[b]But there’s more! [/b]During the live stream, we will give away additional five $100 gift cards.

[b]And that's not all![/b] In addition to the gift cards, we will also give away the game keys.

[h3][i]Giveaway rules:[/i][/h3][olist]
[*] Share this post with your friends no later than January 16!
To do this, click [b]"Share"[/b] under this post, then [b]"Share directly to my status"[/b] and then [b]"Post"[/b]. This news will appear in your Steam profile activity feed.

[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122780/Highly_Likely/][b]Add[/b][/url] the game to your wish list.

[*] Write a funny phrase about our game using the name of the game [b]“Highly Likely”[/b] in the comments to this post to confirm your participation.[/olist]
The draw will take place on January 17 during a live stream. The time of the stream and the link will be announced additionally. [b]Follow the news![/b]

Winners will be selected randomly using the service https://www.random.org/

The cards of the lower value will be given away first, the $100 cards last!

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] If the winner does not meet one or more of the 3 above requirements, they will automatically drop out of the participants and another winner will be chosen.
Prizes will be awarded within 3 days in accordance with the rules for transferring Steam gift cards.

[b]Dear friends, make sure that your steam profile in not private in order to receive your prize![/b]

[i][b]We wish you luck and good mood![/b][/i]ːsteamhappyː

[b]P.S.[/b] We will be very grateful if you share this news with your friends on Facebook or Twitter or Reddit. All you have to do is click “Share” under this post, then “Share on Facebook”, “Share on Twitter”, “Share on Reddit”.

*We run 2 giveaways: One for Russian-speaking players, and another for players from all countries except Russia and CIS. The total number of cards in both giveaways is 105.
